# Pinstripe brand files

**The mark is generated by ChatGPT**: a striped necktie with a gold tie bar, on the green `#0C5449` tile. Nobody draws it and nobody edits the mark's geometry; the PNGs below are the mark. Pinstripe is to code what a well-knotted tie is to a job interview: nobody notices it, but everyone notices when it's missing.

## Files

| File | Size | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `pinstripe-avatar-1024.png` | 749,622 bytes (1024 x 1024) | The full-size mark, for slides, documents, and high-resolution use |
| `pinstripe-avatar-512.png` | 225,451 bytes (512 x 512) | The project avatar and the base for the Open Graph image |
| `pinstripe-avatar-256.png` | 59,795 bytes (256 x 256) | The mark for the site header and hero, and the apple-touch-icon |
| `favicon-64.png` | 5,723 bytes (64 x 64) | The 64 px favicon |
| `favicon-32.png` | 2,053 bytes (32 x 32) | The 32 px favicon |

| `pinstripe-board.png` | 987,369 bytes (3840 x 2710) | The brand board (see below) |

## The board

`pinstripe-board.png` is the 11-panel brand board. It shows the mark as the hero symbol and the app icon, the horizontal and stacked lockups with the wordmark, the mark on light and dark backgrounds, the colour palette (deep green `#0C5449`, gold `#FFCC33`, cream `#F4F1EA`, and a site-accent-only mauve `#8B6372`), the Inter typography, the 64/32/16 px favicons, the clear space and 32 px minimum size, the do-and-don't rules, and the developer workflow from editor to terminal.

## Rules

Do not redraw or edit the mark. The PNGs are the mark; nobody draws or edits the mark's geometry. If a vector is ever needed, trace the PNG with vtracer or potrace.
